title: Implement a least recently used cache with a fixed capacity
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: An OrderedDict moves a key to the most recent end on every hit and every put and evicts from the least recent end, exactly as the brief requires.
put on an existing key replaces the value without making it the most recently used, so after put a, b, a=10, c into capacity 2 it evicts "a" instead of "b".
Removing and re-inserting a key in an insertion-ordered dict on every get hit and put keeps the least recently used key first, and that key is the one evicted.
The cache is written in JavaScript, while the brief asks for a Python class.
